The sandbox holds three Markdown files, and notes/metrics.md contains one sentence over 25 words.

Second, tool checks show only notes/metrics.md exceeds the length threshold.

- notes/metrics.md
- notes/summary.md

No original file in the sandbox was modified [judgment].

The alternative was editing notes/metrics.md immediately to fix the long sentence.
However, this option loses because the user explicitly ordered to keep every file as it is.

# End

1. Record notes/metrics.md as the only target file for future sentence shortening.
Increment: Document the finding in your review notes during this session.
Blocker removed: Removes ambiguity about which file violates the rule.

Blocker removed: Prevents unauthorized modification of user files.

Then all character counts match original values
Cynefin domain: Clear, deduction from explicit instruction.

Increment: Draft a proposed two-sentence replacement in session notes.
Blocker removed: Prepares the fix in advance of approval.
Deterministic test:

When word counts are measured
Then each sentence contains at most 25 words
